definitions.explanation: Eggs beaten and cooked in a pan with stirring, usually served as a breakfast dish. A common Western-style breakfast item in Japan, often paired with bacon, sausage, or toast.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝食|ちょうしょく}→朝食：03122_choushoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧スクランブルエッグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I had scrambled eggs for breakfast.

examples.japanese: ⟦{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}→牛乳：00777_gyuunyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧スクランブルエッグ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ふわふわ→ふわふわ：05156_fuwafuwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Adding milk makes the scrambled eggs fluffy.

examples.japanese: ⟦トースト→トースト：20532_toosuto⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ベーコン→ベーコン：30299_beekon⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧スクランブルエッグ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧になった⟦{洋風|ようふう}→洋風：13282_youfuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{朝食|ちょうしょく}→朝食：03122_choushoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like Western-style breakfasts that come with toast, bacon, and scrambled eggs.

notes:
A Western-style egg dish that has become a familiar part of breakfast menus in cafes, hotels, and family restaurants in Japan. Commonly abbreviated in menus and recipes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スクランブルエッグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make scrambled eggs
- ⟦ふわふわ→ふわふわ：05156_fuwafuwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧スクランブルエッグ: fluffy scrambled eggs
- スクランブルエッグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{添|そ}える→添える：13315_soeru⟧: to serve with scrambled eggs on the side
- ⟦バター→バター：04671_bataa⟧⟦{風味|ふうみ}→風味：14622_fuumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧スクランブルエッグ: buttery scrambled eggs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{卵焼|たまごや}き→卵焼き：10367_tamagoyaki⟧: Japanese-style rolled omelet — sweet or savory, cooked in a rectangular pan; a traditional Japanese dish distinct from スクランブルエッグ
- ⟦オムレツ→オムレツ：10807_omuretsu⟧: omelet — eggs cooked into a folded or rolled shape, often with fillings
- ⟦{目玉焼|めだまや}き→目玉焼き：14946_medamayaki⟧: sunny-side up fried egg — a whole egg fried without stirring
- いり{卵|たまご}: Japanese-style scrambled/stirred eggs — finer and drier than スクランブルエッグ, often used in donburi and bento

CULTURAL NOTE:
Although スクランブルエッグ has become popular, いり{卵|たまご} (finely stirred eggs) and ⟦{卵焼|たまごや}き→卵焼き：10367_tamagoyaki⟧ remain the more traditional Japanese preparations of cooked egg.
